title: Principles of Crop Production
topics: Scope and branches of crop production

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Integrated pest management?
o: the raising of new plants from stems, roots or leaves instead of from seed
the nutrient that promotes root development, flowering and early ripening
the sorting of produce into classes by size, quality or appearance
the blending of cultural, biological and chemical measures to hold pests below damaging levels
items.s: Integrated pest management: the blending of cultural, biological and chemical measures to hold pests below damaging levels. The other options describe Grading, Vegetative propagation, Phosphorus.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Processing.

the fertilised ovule from which a new plant develops
a plant grown to be cut and fed to livestock as green fodder or hay
the turning of a raw farm product into a form fit for eating or sale
items.s: Processing: the turning of a raw farm product into a form fit for eating or sale. The other options describe Seed, Forage crop, Floriculture.

items.q: Which term is described by “a plant grown for its swollen underground root, such as cassava or sweet potato”?

items.s: Root crop is a plant grown for its swollen underground root, such as cassava or sweet potato.
